articles.title: KOSPI plunges 6% and dips below 5,000 as AI data center fears hit chip stocks
articles.easyKo: 미국 중간선거 뒤 AI 데이터센터 규제가 세질 것이라는 걱정이 퍼졌어요. 그래서 코스피가 하루에 6% 넘게 떨어졌고, 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 크게 내렸어요. 정부는 시장이 지나치게 흔들리면 바로 나서겠다고 했어요.

paragraphs.en: South Korea's main stock index, the KOSPI, fell 6.02 percent on Friday and closed at 5,059.69. It dropped more than 8 percent at one point and went below 5,000 for the first time since February. A circuit breaker stopped trading for 20 minutes soon after the market opened. The Kosdaq, a market for smaller tech firms, fell 5.03 percent to 644.27. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix together were worth less than 2 quadrillion won for the first time since April 14.
paragraphs.ko: 한국의 대표 주가지수 코스피가 금요일에 6.02% 떨어져 5,059.69로 마감했어요. 한때 8% 넘게 내려 2월 이후 처음으로 5,000 아래로 떨어졌어요. 장이 열린 직후 서킷브레이커가 발동해 거래가 20분 멈췄어요. 작은 기술 기업이 많은 코스닥은 5.03% 내려 644.27이 됐어요. 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 시가총액 합계는 4월 14일 이후 처음 2,000조 원 아래로 내려갔어요.

It sees a 20% chance that the year will tie or beat 2024, the warmest ever. An unusually strong El Niño is adding heat to warming caused by people. sents.en: Scientists in the United Kingdom have made a gel that could help regrow damaged tooth enamel.

paragraphs.en: Swift could quickly turn its telescopes toward a sudden cosmic event. It then alerted observatories around the world. This helped astronomers study brief events before they faded. Swift also watched many kinds of light, which gave researchers more ways to study the same event.
